Author: Anil Kumar Choudhary Bench: Anil Kumar Choudhary IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI  B.A. No.5279 of 2023  ------

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY  ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Suraj Singh, Advocate  Mr. Vikas Kumar, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Sunil Kr. Dubey, Addl.P.P  ------
 Order No.04 Dated- 21/07/2023  Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Gopikandar P.S. Case No.10 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No.783 of 2021 (S.T. No.07 of 2022) registered under Section 376 (2) (n),
313, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner has committed rape upon the informant since 2013 on the allurement of marriage and caused her miscarriage.
It is submitted that the allegation against the petitioner is false.
It is next submitted that because of marital dispute between the petitioner and the informant, this false case has been foisted against the petitioner by the informant.
It is next submitted that the informant is the wife of the petitioner.
It is also submitted that not a single witness has been examined in the trial so far.

It is further submitted that the co- accused, with similar allegations, have already been given the privileges of anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 06.01.2022 passed in A.B.A.
No.10030 of 2021.
It is then submitted that the petitioner is ready and willing to co-operate with the trial of the case.
It is lastly submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 27.07.2021 which is evident from para-13 of the instant bail application.
Hence it is submitted the petitioner be released on bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

Considering the facts of this case, the above named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like Shamsel Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58874706/
1 amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Dumka in connection with Gopikandar P.S. Case No.10 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No.783 of 2021 (S.T. No.07 of 2022)
with the condition that he will co-operate with the trial of the case.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Animesh/
Shamsel Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58874706/
